biotools.summary: vsgseq2 is a Nextflow-based pipeline for analyzing VSGSeq data, enabling the surveillance of population-wide diversity and abundance of expressed VSGs in *Trypanosoma brucei*. The updated workflow improves computational efficiency and data reproducibility when reconstructing VSG repertoires.
